classes.criteria: reading, analysis, audits, or drafts without mutating files, the repository, or the target
bounded, reversible, non-sensitive mutation with an immediately observable result and no critical surfaces
multi-scope or internal-contract mutation, reversible with effort and without critical surfaces
kernel, authorization, security, privacy, auth, payments, migrations, storage, deployment, releases, public contracts, or hard-to-revert architecture

workflows.use_for: analysis, audits, questions, postcondition verification, and findings without changes
required_behavior: analyze the requested scope and produce findings instead of changes

when an executed action, a reviewed reference, and its expected postconditions are declared, verify each postcondition against the corresponding live evidence (for example effective merge, the main branch's final SHA, correspondence with the reviewed head, post-merge checks, unit closure, remote branch deletion, and local cleanup) and report the state of each without running any mutation

workflows.use_for: implement a traceable, bounded work unit in a target; a GitHub issue is one possible adapter
required_behavior: implement the complete change within the live work-unit scope and nothing else

when the unit corrects an already-reviewed PR, publish exactly one append-only correction report on that PR that references the source review or comment, records the previous and corrected heads, maps each blocking-correction to its outcome, identifies the commits or range and the real validation, states remaining work, and confirms no merge or close happened, without editing the body or any prior comment

workflows.use_for: draft a human-executable plan without mutating the repository or remote target
required_behavior: draft a human-executable plan naming files and anchors only when they can be verified

workflows.use_for: review finished work before PM merge or closure
required_behavior: compare the real implementation and validation against work-unit scope, out of scope, and acceptance criteria

classify every finding with a verifiable disposition: blocking-correction, non-blocking-follow-up, preference, accepted-risk, or invalid-finding; only blocking-correction requires correction before closure
when the verdict is GO, deliver the closeout bundle and its final verification in the same response
audit evidence against boundary.implementation_discipline, boundary.primary_path_discipline, and boundary.validation_discipline
distinguish discipline gaps from acceptable local tradeoffs or explicit project conventions

workflows.use_for: turn PM input into drafted work units, route prompts, or decision requests
required_behavior: present explicitly the decisions the PM must make

workflows.use_for: prepare an asset prompt for an external recipient that is not an actor
required_behavior: identify needed assets and their product, brand, accessibility, format, dimension, and acceptance constraints
keep product and design truth in the target, never in the prompt

workflows.use_for: prepare an OWASP security-review prompt without exposing secrets
required_behavior: identify sensitive target surfaces: authentication, authorization, sessions, input validation, uploads, redirects, dependencies, admin, secrets, logging, and configuration

workflows.use_for: assess tag or release readiness without creating a tag or release
required_behavior: assess readiness and name every open gap

workflows.use_for: transfer a session or work by pointing to live evidence
required_behavior: leave all transferable state in target systems of record before ending the session

workflows.use_for: audit or bootstrap target adapters on this kernel
required_behavior: audit target adapters against canonical adapters and report drift without overwriting target-owned notes, constraints, or commands
when adoption is missing, create or draft only the canonical adapters
keep the adoption diff adapter-only, without product code or extra authority

workflows.use_for: run an internal local or staging deployment with target-owned commands
required_behavior: deploy one environment at a time
verify post-deploy state before reporting
